==================
Directive and comments — "#n quiet\n# plain\n!# negated\n"
:language(gsed)
:language(gsed_ere)
==================
#n quiet
# plain
!# negated

------------------
(script
  (command_list
    (directive
      (directive_text)
      (comment_text))
    (command_separator)
    (comment
      (comment_text))
    (command_separator)
    (command
      negation: (negation)
      (comment
        (comment_text)))
    (command_separator)))

==================
Comment after command — "p#x\n"
:language(gsed)
:language(gsed_ere)
:cst
==================
p#x

------------------
0:0 - 1:0   script
0:0 - 1:0     command_list
0:0 - 0:1       command
0:0 - 0:1         simple_command
0:0 - 0:1           name: command_name `p`
0:1 - 0:3       comment
0:1 - 0:3         comment_text `#x`
0:3 - 1:0       command_separator
0:3 - 0:4         `\n`

==================
Comment rejects addresses — "1#comment"
:language(gsed)
:language(gsed_ere)
:cst
==================
1#comment
------------------
0:0 - 0:9   script
0:0 - 0:9     command_list
0:0 - 0:9       command
0:0 - 0:1         issue: syntax_issue
0:0 - 0:1           invalid_syntax
0:0 - 0:1             excess_address
0:0 - 0:1               address: address_clause
0:0 - 0:1                 address
0:0 - 0:1                   line_address
0:0 - 0:1                     first: number `1`
0:1 - 0:9         comment
0:1 - 0:9           comment_text `#comment`

==================
Negated comment — "!#comment"
:language(gsed)
:language(gsed_ere)
:cst
==================
!#comment
------------------

0:0 - 0:1         negation: negation
0:0 - 0:1           "!"
0:1 - 0:9         comment
0:1 - 0:9           comment_text `#comment`

==================

==================
Directive preserves body whitespace — "#n hi\n"
:language(gsed)
:language(gsed_ere)
:cst
==================
#n hi

------------------
0:0 - 1:0   script
0:0 - 1:0     command_list
0:0 - 0:5       directive
0:0 - 0:2         directive_text `#n`
0:2 - 0:5         comment_text ` hi`
0:5 - 1:0       command_separator
0:5 - 0:6         `\n`

==================
Only the first comment is a directive — "#n hi\n#n\n"
:language(gsed)
:language(gsed_ere)
:cst
==================
#n hi
#n

------------------
0:0 - 2:0   script
0:0 - 2:0     command_list
0:0 - 0:5       directive
0:0 - 0:2         directive_text `#n`
0:2 - 0:5         comment_text ` hi`
0:5 - 1:0       command_separator
0:5 - 0:6         `\n`
1:0 - 1:2       comment
1:0 - 1:2         comment_text `#n`
1:2 - 2:0       command_separator
1:2 - 1:3         `\n`

==================
Initial BOM precedes a directive — "﻿#n\np"
:language(gsed)
:language(gsed_ere)
:cst
==================
﻿#n
p
------------------

0:3 - 1:1     command_list

0:3 - 0:5         directive_text `#n`
0:5 - 1:0       command_separator
0:5 - 0:6         `\n`
1:0 - 1:1       command
1:0 - 1:1         simple_command
1:0 - 1:1           name: command_name `p`
